name: handoff
description: Send notes and the original files from your AI assistant to someone else's: Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code. Free hosted, or your own private server.

interface.shortDescription: Send notes and files to someone else's AI assistant.
interface.longDescription: Say "hand this off to anna" and your assistant writes a brief (purpose, decisions and reasons, constraints, next step, references, open questions), attaches the files you choose, and sends it to anna's Handoff inbox. In her own assistant, Claude or ChatGPT, she says "continue the handoff from joe" and keeps going with the original files. Invite her with "invite anna to Handoff". Also works between your own assistants and computers. Free, with no AI inside.
